verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents user-built ingestion workflows, which can be created with an AI Editor using natural-language prompts and triggered by incoming webhooks. Background continuous monitoring, evidence collection and AI risk auto-scoring are also documented, so some user-configured automation does run unattended. The depth of user-defined autonomous automation is thin, though: the evidence shows only webhook-triggered ingestion and platform-managed monitoring. missing for 10: user-defined recurring schedules or general triggers, autonomous agent-style actions beyond ingestion, run history or controls for automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Sprinto’s AI Editor helps you create and modify ingestion workflows using natural language prompts.
Maintain readiness with continuous monitoring, alerts, and evidence collection.
